mapper.select:
SELECT DI.DIVISION_NAME AS "DIVISION_NAME" ,VE.VENDOR_NAME AS "VENDOR_NAME" ,IM.ITEM_CODE AS "ITEM_CODE" ,IM.ITEM_NAME AS "ITEM_NAME" ,IM.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE" ,PL.ORDER_NO AS "ORDER_NO" ,PL.ORDER_SEQ AS "ORDER_SEQ" ,PL.VENDOR_CODE AS "VENDOR_CODE" ,PL.WAREHOUSING_NO AS "WAREHOUSING_NO" ,PL.DIVISION_CODE AS "PARAM_DIVISION_CODE" ,PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO AS "COO_CERTIFY_NO" ,CASE WHEN PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO IS NULL OR PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO = '' THEN '미등록' ELSE COALESCE(CD.CODE_NAME, '등록') END AS "SUBMIT_STATUS"
FROM PO_LEDGER PL
INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE
INNER JOIN VENDOR VE ON VE.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND VE.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE
INNER JOIN DIVISION DI ON DI.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND DI.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE
LEFT JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM ON ECM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND ECM.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE AND ECM.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO = PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'N'
LEFT JOIN CODE_DTL CD ON CD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE AND CD.CATEGORY = 'SS' AND CD.CODE = CAST(ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS AS TEXT) AND CD.DELETE_YN = 'N'
WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE}
AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = #{plant}
AND TO_DATE( NULLIF(CAST(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE AS TEXT), ''), 'YYYYMMDD' ) >= TO_DATE(#{search_from_date}, 'YYYYMMDD')
AND TO_DATE( NULLIF(CAST(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE AS TEXT), ''), 'YYYYMMDD' ) <= TO_DATE(#{search_to_date}, 'YYYYMMDD')
AND PL.WAREHOUSING_TYPE = #{warehousing_type}
AND ( CAST(IM.ITEM_CODE AS TEXT) ILIKE '%' || #{search_key_word} || '%' OR IM.ITEM_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search_key_word} || '%' )
AND CAST(PL.ORDER_NO AS TEXT) ILIKE '%' || #{search_key_word} || '%'
AND ( CAST(VE.VENDOR_CODE AS TEXT) ILIKE '%' || #{search_key_word} || '%' OR VE.VENDOR_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search_key_word} || '%' )
ORDER BY PL.DIVISION_CODE ,PL.VENDOR_CODE ,PL.ORDER_NO ,PL.ORDER_SEQ ,PL.WAREHOUSING_NO ,IM.ITEM_CODE

WITH BASE_ITEM AS ( SELECT DISTINCT PL.COMPANY_CODE ,PL.DIVISION_CODE ,PL.VENDOR_CODE ,PL.ITEM_CODE FROM PO_LEDGER PL WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ), LATEST_CERTIFY AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON ( ECM.COMPANY_CODE ,ECM.DIVISION_CODE ,ECM.VENDOR_CODE ,ECD.ITEM_CODE ) ECM.COMPANY_CODE ,ECM.DIVISION_CODE ,ECM.VENDOR_CODE ,ECD.ITEM_CODE ,ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO ,CAST(ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS AS TEXT) AS SUBMIT_STATUS ,CD.CODE_NAME AS SUBMIT_STATUS_NAME ,CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(ECD.ISSUE_DATE), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(BTRIM(ECD.ISSUE_DATE), 'YYYYMMDD') END AS ISSUE_DATE FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM INNER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD ON ECD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE AND ECD.DIVISION_CODE = ECM.DIVISION_CODE AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = ECM.VENDOR_CODE AND ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO LEFT JOIN CODE_DTL CD ON CD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE AND CD.CATEGORY = 'SS' AND CD.CODE = CAST(ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS AS TEXT) AND CD.DELETE_YN = 'N' WHERE ECM.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'N' ORDER BY ECM.COMPANY_CODE ,ECM.DIVISION_CODE ,ECM.VENDOR_CODE ,ECD.ITEM_CODE ,ISSUE_DATE DESC NULLS LAST ,ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO DESC ) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE LC.COO_CERTIFY_NO IS NULL ) AS "unregisteredItemCount"
,COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE LC.SUBMIT_STATUS_NAME = '제출완료' ) AS "submittedItemCount"
,0 AS "expiringWithin30DaysItemCount"
,COUNT(*) AS "totalItemCount"
FROM BASE_ITEM BI
LEFT JOIN LATEST_CERTIFY LC ON LC.COMPANY_CODE = BI.COMPANY_CODE AND LC.DIVISION_CODE = BI.DIVISION_CODE AND LC.VENDOR_CODE = BI.VENDOR_CODE AND LC.ITEM_CODE = BI.ITEM_CODE

choose.when:
SELECT '1' AS "CHECKED"
,ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO AS "COO_CERTIFY_NO" ,TO_CHAR( TO_DATE(NULLIF(CAST(ECM.ISSUE_DATE AS TEXT), ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS "ISSUE_DATE"
,ECM.AUTO_COO_YN AS "AUTO_COO_YN" ,ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS AS "SUBMIT_STATUS"
,ECD.ITEM_CODE AS "ITEM_CODE" ,IM.ITEM_NAME AS "ITEM_NAME"
,COALESCE(IM.ITEM_NAME, '') || CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(IM.SPEC), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' || IM.SPEC END AS "ITEM_SPEC"
,ECD.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE"
,ECD.FTA_CODE AS "FTA_CODE" ,FM.FTA_NAME AS "FTA_NAME"
,ECD.COO_YN AS "COO_YN"
,CASE WHEN ECD.COO_YN = 'Y' THEN '충족' WHEN ECD.COO_YN = 'N' THEN '불충족' ELSE '' END AS "COO_YN_NM"
,ECD.RULE_CODE AS "RULE_CODE" ,ECD.RULE_CODE AS "RULE_CODE_NM"
,ECD.RVC_RATE AS "RVC_RATE"
,ECD.COO_NATION AS "COO_NATION" ,NC.CODE_NAME AS "COO_NATION_NM"
,ECD.WAREHOUSING_NO AS "WAREHOUSING_NO" ,ECD.WAREHOUSING_SEQ AS "WAREHOUSING_SEQ"
,PL.ORDER_NO AS "ORDER_NO" ,PL.ORDER_SEQ AS "ORDER_SEQ"
,TO_CHAR( TO_DATE( NULLIF(CAST(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE AS TEXT), ''), 'YYYYMMDD' ), 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS "WAREHOUSING_DATE"
,ECD.DIVISION_CODE AS "PARAM_DIVISION_CODE"
,CAST(ECD.WAREHOUSING_NO AS TEXT) || '_' || CAST(ECD.WAREHOUSING_SEQ AS TEXT) || '_' || CAST(ECD.ITEM_CODE AS TEXT) || '_' || CAST(ECD.FTA_CODE AS TEXT) AS "ROW_ID"
FROM EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM
INNER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD ON ECD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE AND ECD.DIVISION_CODE = ECM.DIVISION_CODE AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = ECM.VENDOR_CODE AND ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO
INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = ECD.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = ECD.ITEM_CODE
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT FTA_CODE, FTA_NAME FROM FTA_MASTER WHERE DELETE_YN = 'N' ) FM ON FM.FTA_CODE = ECD.FTA_CODE
LEFT JOIN CODE_DTL NC ON NC.COMPANY_CODE = ECD.COMPANY_CODE AND NC.CATEGORY = 'ON' AND NC.CODE = ECD.COO_NATION AND NC.DELETE_YN = 'N'
LEFT JOIN PO_LEDGER PL ON PL.COMPANY_CODE = ECD.COMPANY_CODE AND PL.DIVISION_CODE = ECD.DIVISION_CODE AND PL.VENDOR_CODE = ECD.VENDOR_CODE AND PL.ITEM_CODE = ECD.ITEM_CODE AND CAST(PL.WAREHOUSING_NO AS TEXT) = CAST(ECD.WAREHOUSING_NO AS TEXT) AND CAST(PL.SEQ AS TEXT) = CAST(ECD.WAREHOUSING_SEQ AS TEXT)
WHERE ECM.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} AND ECM.DIVISION_CODE = #{PARAM_DIVISION_CODE} AND ECM.VENDOR_CODE = #{PARAM_VENDOR_CODE} AND ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO = #{COO_CERTIFY_NO} AND ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'N'
ORDER BY ECD.WAREHOUSING_NO ,ECD.ITEM_CODE ,ECD.HS_CODE ,ECD.FTA_CODE
choose.otherwise:
SELECT '0' AS "CHECKED"
,NULL AS "COO_CERTIFY_NO" ,NULL AS "ISSUE_DATE" ,NULL AS "AUTO_COO_YN" ,NULL AS "SUBMIT_STATUS"
,IM.ITEM_CODE AS "ITEM_CODE" ,IM.ITEM_NAME AS "ITEM_NAME"
,COALESCE(IM.ITEM_NAME, '') || CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(IM.SPEC), '') IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' || IM.SPEC END AS "ITEM_SPEC"
,IM.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE"
,FM.FTA_CODE AS "FTA_CODE" ,FM.FTA_NAME AS "FTA_NAME"
,'Y' AS "COO_YN" ,'충족' AS "COO_YN_NM"
,NULL AS "RULE_CODE" ,NULL AS "RULE_CODE_NM" ,NULL AS "RVC_RATE"
,'KR' AS "COO_NATION" ,'대한민국' AS "COO_NATION_NM"
,PL.ORDER_NO AS "ORDER_NO" ,PL.ORDER_SEQ AS "ORDER_SEQ"
,PL.WAREHOUSING_NO AS "WAREHOUSING_NO" ,PL.SEQ AS "WAREHOUSING_SEQ"
,TO_CHAR( TO_DATE( NULLIF(CAST(PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE AS TEXT), ''), 'YYYYMMDD' ), 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS "WAREHOUSING_DATE"
,PL.DIVISION_CODE AS "PARAM_DIVISION_CODE"
,VE.SIGN_FILE_NAME AS "SIGN_FILE_NAME"
,CAST(PL.WAREHOUSING_NO AS TEXT) || '_' || CAST(PL.SEQ AS TEXT) || '_' || CAST(IM.ITEM_CODE AS TEXT) || '_' || CAST(FM.FTA_CODE AS TEXT) AS "ROW_ID"
FROM PO_LEDGER PL
INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND IM.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE
INNER JOIN VENDOR VE ON VE.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND VE.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE
INNER JOIN FTA_MASTER FM ON FM.DELETE_YN = 'N'
WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE}
AND CAST(PL.ORDER_NO AS TEXT) = CAST(#{PARAM_ORDER_NO} AS TEXT)
AND CAST(PL.ORDER_SEQ AS TEXT) = CAST(#{PARAM_ORDER_SEQ} AS TEXT)
AND PL.VENDOR_CODE = #{PARAM_VENDOR_CODE}
AND COALESCE(PL.COO_TYPE, 'N') != 'C'
AND ( PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO IS NULL OR PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO = '' )
GROUP BY IM.ITEM_CODE ,IM.ITEM_NAME ,IM.SPEC ,IM.HS_CODE ,FM.FTA_CODE ,FM.FTA_NAME ,PL.ORDER_NO ,PL.ORDER_SEQ ,PL.WAREHOUSING_NO ,PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE ,PL.DIVISION_CODE ,VE.SIGN_FILE_NAME ,PL.SEQ
ORDER BY PL.WAREHOUSING_NO ,IM.ITEM_CODE ,IM.HS_CODE ,FM.FTA_CODE

mapper.select: WITH PARAMS AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(CAST(#{hsCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_ARRAY( BTRIM(CAST(#{hsCodes,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS TEXT)), '[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*' ) END AS HS_CODE_ARRAY ) SELECT FR.FTA_CODE AS "FTA_CODE" ,HC.HS_CODE AS "HS_CODE" ,FR.RULE_CONTENTS AS "COMP_RULE" ,CASE WHEN FR.BD_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.BD_RULE WHEN FR.BU_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.BU_RULE WHEN FR.NC_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.NC_RULE WHEN FR.MC_RULE IS NOT NULL THEN FR.MC_RULE END AS "RVC_RATE" FROM FTA_RULE FR CROSS JOIN PARAMS P INNER JOIN HS_CODE HC ON FR.HS_CODE = SUBSTR(HC.HS_CODE, 1, LENGTH(FR.HS_CODE)) WHERE CAST(HC.HS_CODE AS TEXT) = ANY(P.HS_CODE_ARRAY) AND FR.HS_CODE_SUB_CATEGORY = '1' ORDER BY HC.HS_CODE ,FR.FTA_CODE ,FR.RULE_SEQ ,FR.CTH_RULE
SELECT CODE AS "CODE" ,CODE_NAME AS "CODE_NAME" FROM CODE_DTL WHERE CATEGORY = 'ON' AND COMPANY_CODE = #{COMPANY_CODE} ORDER BY SORT_NO
